Jordan: opened a PR that adds a KV-cache-aware section to the 429/runbook page + a tiny SDK example for graceful fallback. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/1234
Maria: saw it, nice. does it cover when to prefer prefix vs full replay?
Jordan: brief callout for prefix-first, replay-only if prefix miss + short code sample. still needs a link from the SDK snippets index though.
Keon: can we make the snippet non-blocking? i.e. show streaming resume + a fast fallback path to avoid double-token generation. pseudo snippet below:
```python
# use prefix KV cache, fall back to short-prefix replay on 429
prefix = kv_cache.get_prefix(session_id)
try:
    for chunk in client.generate_stream(prompt, kv_cache=prefix):
        yield chunk
except TooManyRequests:
    # fast fallback: request short prefix (cheap) and return best-effort tokens
    resp = client.generate(prompt, kv_cache=prefix.truncate(16), max_tokens=64)
    return resp
```
